AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe contraction in sales (-56.3%) and earnings (-25.5%) invalidates CANSLIM criteria. Return on capital employed is sub-par at 5.6% with thin 2.3% net margins.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails on breach of the double-bottom pivot floor at 103.61; exit cleanly to prevent capital erosion.

ACUTAAS.technical: Textbook Stage 2 advance; clearing double bottom at 4049.35 with bullish moving-average stack and RSI at 68 signaling leadership.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Pristine CANSLIM profile: EBITDA margin widened to 40.3%, net profit up 71.4%, robust ROCE of 31.6%, virtually debt-free balance sheet.
ACUTAAS.risk: Invalidated if price undercuts swing support at 3637.50; strictly honor stop to protect open equity.

ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Sales expansion intact, but EPS growth moderated from 38.8% to 15.0% YoY. Capital intensity keeps interest coverage tight and ROCE modest at 7.4%.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Setup breaks down on violation of breakout support at 1329.50; execute strict stop-loss discipline.

ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Healthy industry-leading EBITDA margins (60%+) and 23.7% revenue growth, but latest EPS YoY (+17.3%) misses the 25% CANSLIM threshold.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Pattern fails if price falls below trailing shelf at 1776.35; enforce stop without hesitation.

AEROFLEX.fundamental: Exceptional O'Neil CANSLIM credentials: Q2 revenue up 87%, PAT surged 157% powered by high-margin data center liquid cooling, ROCE at 18.9%.
AEROFLEX.risk: Thesis invalid if price breaks below base support at 529.97; cut losses immediately.
